ns2:course.label: Inter Agricultural Finance
ns2:course.description: (ACE 343) Examination of finance principles applied to commercial agriculture at an intermediate level; farm financial and investment analysis, risk and liquidity analysis, capital structure and leasing in agriculture; and organization, structure, and analysis of rural financial markets and institutions. 3 undergraduate hours. 3 or 4 graduate hours. Prerequisite: ACE 340 and 261, or equivalent.
